main_body: Flat grass ground patch (terrain tile) with a few small flowers; no standing volume
top_band: none (flat terrain, uniform green with scattered darker tufts)
evidence: Terrain ground tile: a flat grass surface seen from above with scattered dark tufts and a few small flower sprites. It is not a standing object, so the top/front structure contract does not apply, and no side face or elevation is drawn. The column scan shows only a uniform mid green with 1-row darker tufts.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and a median of 8 colours per tile, against 80 colours and 26 per tile in the reference grass. Flat-fill coverage is 22% against 0% for the reference. The grass uses essentially one mid green with a lighter and a darker tuft tone, so it shows about 3 shading steps against the reference's 5 or more. The reference grass has clumped blades in several greens and varied patches. The candidate's tufts are sparse single pixels or 2-pixel marks over large flat areas, which reads as thinner and flatter than the reference. There is no outline. The flowers are a nice touch but cannot make up for the flat base.
